components.name: Dropzone
components.description: Drag and drop, click to browse or paste files, with type, size and count validation, previews for images, GIFs, video, audio and documents, progress, retry, remove, reorder and a total; the native input stays in sync so a normal form submit sends the files. It needs monsoon.js. Without it the native file input still works.

api.attribute: data-m-dropzone on a .dropzone that wraps a label.dropzone-area with an <input type="file">

options.data-m-dropzone-max-size: Largest file, like 10mb, 500kb or a byte count.
options.data-m-dropzone-max-files: Most files in the list (1 when the input has no multiple attribute).
options.data-m-dropzone-accept: Accepted types, defaults to the input accept attribute (image/*, .pdf, application/zip).
options.data-m-dropzone-simulate: false turns off the simulated upload progress, files are marked done at once.

methods.Monsoon.dropzone(el).add(files): Validates and adds files, returns the accepted ones.
methods.Monsoon.dropzone(el).validate(files): Returns { accepted, errors } without adding anything.

events.monsoon:dropzone-change: detail.files after any add, remove or reorder.
events.monsoon:dropzone-upload: One per file. Call event.preventDefault() to upload it yourself and report with detail.progress(0 to 1), detail.done(response) and detail.error(message).
events.monsoon:dropzone-complete: detail.file and detail.response when an upload finishes.
events.monsoon:dropzone-failed: detail.file and detail.error; the row shows a retry button.
events.monsoon:dropzone-error: detail.errors: [{ file, code, message }] for rejected files (code is type, size, count or duplicate).
events.monsoon:dropzone-reorder: detail.from, detail.to and detail.files after a drag or Arrow key move on the handle.

components.name: Dropzone compact
components.description: A single row dropzone for tight forms, here for one PDF up to 2 MB. It needs monsoon.js.

api.attribute: Add dropzone-compact next to dropzone. Same options, methods and events as the dropzone.

components.name: Image cropper
components.description: Move and resize the crop box with its handles or the keyboard, pick an aspect (free, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:4, circle), zoom with the slider, wheel or a pinch, rotate, flip, and export to a canvas, Blob, data URL or File. Drop or paste another image to crop it. It needs monsoon.js. Without it the image is shown as is.
components.html: Live preview

api.attribute: data-m-cropper on a .cropper that contains an

options.data-m-cropper-aspect: Starting aspect: free, circle, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:4 or any w:h or number.
options.data-m-cropper-aspects: Comma list of the presets in the toolbar, or none.
options.data-m-cropper-preview: Selector of preview elements, the nearest match is used; each gets the cropper-preview class.
options.data-m-cropper-max: Caps the long side of exports in pixels.

methods.Monsoon.cropper(el).toBlob(type, quality: Promise of a Blob. options: { width, height, max, circle, background }.
methods.Monsoon.cropper(el).toFile(name, type, q: Promise of a File, ready for FormData.
methods.Monsoon.cropper(el).toCanvas(options): A canvas with the crop at source resolution.
methods.Monsoon.cropper(el).getData(): { x, y, width, height } in source pixels of the turned image, plus rotate, flipX, flipY and zoom.
methods.Monsoon.cropper(el).setAspect(name): Changes the aspect, keeping the centre and area.
methods.Monsoon.cropper(el).zoom(value): Zoom from 1 (whole image) to max zoom.
methods.Monsoon.cropper(el).setBox({ x, y, w, h: Places the crop box in stage pixels.
methods.Monsoon.cropper(el).load(srcOrFile): Loads another image, returns a Promise.

events.monsoon:cropper-ready: The image is loaded, detail is the crop data.
events.monsoon:crop: The crop changed (once per frame while dragging), detail is the crop data.

api.keyboard: Focus the crop box: arrows move it, Shift and arrows resize it, Ctrl or Alt moves 10 pixels, plus and minus zoom.

components.name: Avatar upload
components.description: Click, drop or paste a picture to crop it in a circle inside a dialog; saving puts the cropped File into the file input so FormData sends it, writes a data URL into a hidden input when there is one and updates the picture. It needs monsoon.js. Without it the original file is sent.
components.html: Profile photoPNG, JPG or GIF up to 8 MB. Click the picture or drop an image on it.

api.attribute: data-m-avatar-upload on an .avatar-upload with a label.avatar-upload-trigger holding an <input type="file">

options.data-m-avatar-upload-size: Output width and height in pixels, 512 by default.
options.data-m-avatar-upload-type: Output type: image/png (default), image/jpeg or image/webp.
options.data-m-avatar-upload-hidden: Selector of a hidden input for the data URL, defaults to a hidden input inside.

methods.Monsoon.avatarUpload(el).open(file): Opens the crop dialog for a File.
methods.Monsoon.avatarUpload(el).cropper: The cropper API inside the dialog.

events.monsoon:avatar-change: detail.file, detail.dataURL and detail.data after saving.

components.name: Image viewer
components.description: Opens linked images in a full screen viewer with zoom (buttons, wheel, pinch, double click or double tap), pan, swipe, arrow keys, captions, a counter, thumbnails and a download button. It needs monsoon.js. Without it each link opens its image.

api.attribute: data-m-image-viewer on any element that holds the links; the viewer dialog is created on first open

options.data-m-image-viewer-selector: Which children open the viewer, a[href], [data-src] by default. Captions come from data-caption, then the image alt.
options.data-m-image-viewer-loop: false stops at the first and last image.

api.keyboard: Left and Right change image, Home and End jump, plus, minus and 0 zoom, Escape closes.

components.name: Media gallery
components.description: A grid of thumbnails with selection (Shift click selects a range, Escape clears), select all, delete, drag or Alt and arrow keys to reorder, and the image viewer on click. It needs monsoon.js. Without it the links open the images and the checkboxes submit with the form.

api.attribute: data-m-media-gallery on a .gallery with a ul.gallery-list of li.gallery-item

options.data-m-media-gallery-viewer: false turns off the image viewer.

events.monsoon:gallery-delete: Cancelable, detail.items and detail.values; call preventDefault() to keep them.
events.monsoon:gallery-reorder: detail.from, detail.to and detail.order (values in the new order).

api.keyboard: Space on a checkbox selects, Shift click selects a range, Ctrl or Cmd click on a picture selects, Delete removes the selection, Alt and arrows move a picture, Escape clears.

components.name: Media gallery masonry
components.description: The same gallery in balanced columns that keep each picture at its own height. It needs monsoon.js.

api.attribute: Add gallery-masonry next to gallery. Set --gallery-min for the column width and --gallery-gap for the gap.

components.name: Before and after compare
components.description: Two pictures (or any two elements) split by a divider that follows the pointer, a finger or the keyboard through a native range input, with optional labels. It needs monsoon.js. Without it a fixed half and half split shows.
components.html: BeforeAfter

options.data-m-compare-position: Starting position in percent, 50 by default (or the range value).
options.data-m-compare-orientation: vertical splits top and bottom, like the compare-vertical class.
options.data-m-compare-hover: true makes the divider follow a mouse without pressing.

api.keyboard: Arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End on the range input.

components.name: Compare vertical
components.description: A top and bottom split. It needs monsoon.js.
components.html: BeforeAfter

api.attribute: Add compare-vertical next to compare. Same API as the compare.

components.name: Signature pad
components.description: Smooth, speed and pressure aware strokes with pen colors and width, undo, clear, PNG and SVG export, and strokes that survive a resize; the result goes into a hidden input. A typed name field stays available for people who cannot draw. It needs monsoon.js. Without it only the typed name field shows.

api.attribute: data-m-signature on a .signature; the pad, canvas and toolbar are created when missing

options.data-m-signature-colors: Comma list of pen colors, CSS colors or tokens, var(--foreground),var(--primary),var(--info) by default.
options.data-m-signature-width: Pen width in pixels, 2.5 by default.
options.data-m-signature-format: png (default) or svg, for the hidden input value.
options.data-m-signature-input: Selector of the hidden input, defaults to one inside.
options.data-m-signature-placeholder: Text on the empty pad, Sign here by default.

methods.Monsoon.signature(el).toDataURL(type, qu: PNG by default. options: { scale, background }.
methods.Monsoon.signature(el).toSVG(options): SVG markup string with one path per segment.
methods.Monsoon.signature(el).undo() and clear(): Removes the last or every stroke.

events.monsoon:signature-change: detail.empty and detail.strokes after each stroke, undo or clear.

api.keyboard: Ctrl or Cmd and Z undoes while the pad has focus.
